versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-search-detail-comment-creator.

- Provides structured access to Xiaohongshu (小红书) public data for content creators, including high-like posts, hot comments, and competitor styles.
- Supports four main data outputs: note list (search), single note details, comment data, and influencer post collections.
- Command-line tools for retrieving and analyzing topic selection, viral posts, comment sentiment, and influencer tracking.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Only retrieves and structures data—does not generate content, log in, or interact with Xiaohongshu.
- Includes comprehensive verification and error handling for links, keywords, and API responses.
